correlation_policy: Fresh interval IAT and 5/10/20 blocks; no averaging of errors or IATs
definitions: Degree counts distinct inter-star neighbors; satellites are non-singleton components outside one largest component; L1 parallel bond pairs, L2 triangles
independent_units: three histories, Student-t df=2; overlapping comparisons are not independent evidence
transient: All 0–1M frames retained as context, not stationary comparators
uncertainty: paired history means only; no combination of window SEMs or IATs; exploratory unadjusted intervals
